description: This file contains extension methods for configuring default Azure Storage options in a testing context, utilizing Azure SDK classes and custom configuration settings.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure Storage options with default settings for testing purposes.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the provided AzureStorageOperationOptions with default test settings, including table service client.

methods.name: GetTableServiceClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a TableServiceClient instance based on the default configuration, using either AAD authentication or connection string.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.GrainDirectory.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the GrainDirectory AzureStorage options with default test settings.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the Persistence AzureStorage options with default test settings.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Reminders.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the Reminders AzureStorage options with default test settings.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Configuration.AzureBlobStorageOptions)
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Storage options with default settings, choosing between AAD credentials and connection string.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Configuration.AzureQueueOptions)
methods.description: Configures Azure Queue Storage options with default settings, choosing between AAD credentials and connection string.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Configuration.AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions)
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Lease Provider options with default settings, choosing between AAD credentials and connection string.
